name: Office of Government Ethics

summary.text: The U.S. Office of Government Ethics (OGE) administers the executive-branch ethics programme, including the public financial disclosure system created by the Ethics in Government Act of 1978. Its OGE Form 278e collects financial information from senior executive-branch officials and presidential nominees for conflict-of-interest review and public disclosure, under 5 U.S.C. 13104 and OGE's regulations at 5 CFR part 2634.

sources.title: Office of Government Ethics: Agency Information Collection Activities; OGE Form 278e
Executive Branch Personnel Public Financial Disclosure Reports (OGE Form 278e)

facts.claim: OGE's Form 278e collects information from certain officers and high-level executive-branch employees for conflict-of-interest review and public disclosure, including individuals nominated by the President for Senate-confirmed positions.
facts.quote: certain officers and high-level employees in the executive branch for conflicts of interest review and public disclosure

sources.title: Office of Government Ethics: Agency Information Collection Activities; OGE Form 278e

facts.claim: The public financial disclosure collection is authorised by 5 U.S.C. 13104 and implemented by OGE's regulations at 5 CFR part 2634.

sources.title: Office of Government Ethics information collection notice, OGE Form 278e

facts.claim: Senior U.S. government officials are required to make detailed public financial disclosures under the Ethics in Government Act; the reports prepared in 2015 for Obama administration officials are held by the Obama Presidential Library.
facts.quote: senior United States Government officials must follow detailed requirements regarding public financial disclosures

sources.title: Executive Branch Personnel Public Financial Disclosure Reports (OGE Form 278e)

facts.claim: Beginning in 2016 executive-branch public filers were required to use only the OGE Form 278e, which replaced the older OGE Form 278, with most filers submitting through an electronic filing system.
facts.quote: Beginning in 2016, executive branch public filers will use only the OGE Form 278e.
